counters.subject: Harbour City.midfield
counters.reason: A coached increase in press intensity should show as substantially more high-intensity runs from the midfield; if the tactic drove the pressure, midfield sprint count should rise by ≥30% vs the first half.

counters.subject: Harbour City.attack
counters.reason: If Harbour City are chasing the score, attackers typically make more sprints into advanced areas; chasing should therefore produce a ≥30% rise in attack sprint count vs the first half.
